name: Dipropylene glycol monomethyl ether
description: Dipropylene glycol monomethyl ether (CAS 20324-32-7 ), commonly abbreviated as DPM, is a slow-evaporating glycol ether solvent used across coatings, cleaning, and electronics manufacturing. Its controlled evaporation rate and strong solvency make it a preferred carrier in formulations where film formation and surface wetting are critical to end-product performance. In architectural and industrial coatings, DPM improves flow and leveling in waterborne and solvent-based systems, reducing surface defects in applied films during the drying process. Electronics manufacturers use it as a precision cleaning agent and flux carrier, where residue-free evaporation is essential for maintaining circuit board integrity and performance. In printing inks and packaging adhesives, it functions as a coalescing solvent that extends open time and improves substrate adhesion for high-quality finishes and bonding. Formulators of sealants and adhesives incorporate it as a reactive diluent carrier to control viscosity during application, ensuring consistent results across various industrial environments. The material is supplied as a clear liquid in drums, IBCs, and bulk tanker quantities. It is available in technical grade for industrial solvent applications and higher-purity grades. The commercial product is typically a mixture of isomers, and suppliers may specify isomer composition where specific purity requirements demand it for specialty coatings end uses.
